note: CORRECTED AFTER ACCOUNTING AUDIT 2026-07-24: delta-neutral funding harvest on top ~50 liquid perps + idle-capital cash yield. The previous v3 figures were too optimistic because (1) short-spot borrowing cost was omitted and (2) the leverage sweep incorrectly multiplied the cash yield. Correct walk-forward OOS at 1x: ~10.9%/yr, 0.0283%/day, Sharpe 7.1, ~71% winning days, DD about -0.4%. At 5x: ~0.134%/day and worst day about -1.9%. The 0.25%/day target is reached only around 10x, where worst day is about -3.7%; therefore NO tested leverage meets both the return target and the -2% daily-loss target. Paper-forward must validate live behavior before real money.
data_source: Binance Vision public dumps (funding + perp/spot 8h klines), data/cache/vision_* (~101 coins downloaded; top 50 by liquidity used)
what_improved: Loop 1: fixed-slot equal-weight deployment beat active-rebalance and beat concentration (diversification wins).
Loop 3: static leverage is the clean return dial (vol-targeting did not help).
Loop 4: 24-period mean funding forecast + basis-consistency filter; longer lookback cut whipsaw.
Loop 5: walk-forward + cost-stress; params stable across all folds (not overfit).
v3-A: IDLE-CAPITAL CASH YIELD (5%/yr) on undeployed capital -> the 'runs when others don't' sleeve; lifts return AND Sharpe (near-riskless), kicks in exactly in thin-funding regimes.

v3-B: LIQUIDITY CURATION to top ~50 perps by dollar volume -> restores the tiny tail (small/illiquid alts added blowup risk). Inverse-vol weighting and per-trade conviction leverage were tested and REJECTED (see research JSONs).
mechanics: Per coin, market-neutral: collect POSITIVE funding via short-perp+long-spot; collect NEGATIVE funding via long-perp+short-spot. Hysteresis entry (24-bar mean funding must beat the cost hurdle) + basis filter + hold until decay. Equal weight across active coins (fixed 8 slots). Undeployed capital earns ~5%/yr cash/stablecoin yield.
universe: auto: top 50 perps by average dollar volume (research.funding_lab.curated_universe)

cost_stress_taker_only_leg0.0022_oos_spl.note: still positive under pessimistic fees; this field is the fixed 55/45 OOS split

assumptions_honest: Cash yield 5%/yr assumes stablecoin lending/T-bill-backed yield is available. Short spot borrow is conservatively modeled at 10%/yr but actual rates and availability vary materially. Curation uses dollar volume and an 8h grid; 4h-funding coins are under-captured. Backtest is not a promise.
